name: aws_lambda_high_error_rate_otel
title: Lambda error rate above 5%
description: A Lambda function failed in more than 5% of its invocations in the last 15 minutes, with at least 5 errors. The 5-error floor keeps rarely run functions from firing on one failure.

query_condition.sql: SELECT res AS function_name, account_id, region, sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'Errors' THEN s ELSE 0 END) AS errors, sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'Invocations' THEN s ELSE 0 END) AS invocations FROM (SELECT dimensions_functionname AS res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp, max(value_sum) AS s FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/Lambda' AND metric_name IN ('Errors', 'Invocations') AND dimensions_functionname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY res, metric_name, account_id, region, timestamp) AS t GROUP BY function_name, account_id, region HAVING sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'Errors' THEN s ELSE 0 END) >= 5 AND sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'Errors' THEN s ELSE 0 END) > 0.05 * sum(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'Invocations' THEN s ELSE 0 END)
